what: Phase 1 completed: Tri-Factor Relevance Ranking and Code Staleness Detection implemented and fully verified against CI gates
why: Phase 1 of sv-memory enhancements: improve search relevance with composite scoring and detect stale code references in memory bindings
learned: Tri-Factor ranking (BM25 + Importance weighting + Recency decay) combines cleanly in SQL FTS5 queries without breaking negative BM25 test contracts; AST stale binding detection in DiagnoseGraph flags memories whose where_path targets deleted files.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
